messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square for maximizing the minimum triangle area arranges all 13 points on the boundary, with 4 points at the corners and 9 points distributed along the edges in a ratio of 2:2:2:3, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/36. This boundary-optimal arrangement exploits the fact that any interior point necessarily creates smaller triangles with nearby boundary points than can be achieved by redistributing that point to the most sparsely populated edge."}
